label: education_handout
text:
HOME CARE INSTRUCTIONS: NECK STRAIN
A neck strain is a stretch or tear of the muscles in the neck. Most people get better in 2 to 6 weeks.
- Use ice for 20 minutes several times a day for the first 2 days.
- Gentle range-of-motion exercises: tilt your head slowly side to side.
Call your doctor if you have weakness, numbness, or loss of bladder control.
